name_en: Levy-Khinchin representation for a Levy process
category: probability and stochastic processes / stochastic processes
canonical_claim: For a real-valued Levy process X, the characteristic function of X_t has exponential time dependence and its characteristic exponent has Levy-Khinchin drift, Gaussian, and jump-measure data; the exact normalization and whether the converse is included remain to be fixed from one primary-source statement.
domain_and_universes: Intended domain: a real-valued process indexed by nonnegative real time on a filtered probability space; the exact process, filtration, law, and measure APIs and Lean universes are open.
ordered_binders_pending: process X with X_0 = 0, stationary independent increments, and the selected continuity hypothesis
time t >= 0 and Fourier variable u in R
Levy triplet relative to one fixed truncation convention
hypotheses: X is a real-valued Levy process under the exact selected definition
the jump measure satisfies the selected Levy-measure integrability condition
conclusion: The characteristic function of X_t equals exp(t times a characteristic exponent), with that exponent represented by the selected Levy-Khinchin formula; any converse or triplet uniqueness is included only if the frozen source theorem includes it.

alternate_encodings.relationship: classically related through the marginal convolution semigroup
classically equivalent under the required continuity and probability hypotheses

boundary_cases: The zero process, pure drift, Brownian motion, compound Poisson processes, t = 0, u = 0, and vanishing drift/Gaussian/jump components remain in scope. Multidimensional and Banach-space versions are not silently substituted.
